title: Single-pullback cotensorator on adjunction-unit tensor sections
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $M,N$ sheaves of $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $U$ an open of $X$, $s\in\Gamma(U,M)$ and $t\in\Gamma(U,N)$. For the fixed monoidal pullback [lem-pc-scheme-pullback-monoidal-existing] and its canonical adjunction unit $\eta$, the cotensorator $\delta_f$ sends $\eta_{M\otimes N}(s\otimes t)$ over $f^{-1}U$ to $\eta_M(s)\otimes\eta_N(t)$, with section tensors as in [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. This asserts only a section formula for one morphism, not composition or unit-object coherence.

source.place: Definition 6.26.1(2), extension-of-scalars pullback formula; Lemma 6.26.2, Tag 0096, canonical pullback-pushforward adjunction. The single-morphism elementary-section calculation is transported by the fixed pullbackMonoidal localization construction.

proof.text: Apply the presheaf pullback adjunction homEquiv formula for its cotensorator. Evaluate at a pure tensor, use tensorHom_app_tmul and pushforward_μ_app_tmul, obtaining the tensor of the two presheaf unit images.

The sheafification adjunction is monoidal, so its unit sends a pure tensor through its cotensorator to tmulSection of the two unit images. The uniqueness-of-left-adjoints comparison sheafificationCompPullback identifies the units of the two composite adjunctions. Its monoidality, supplied by the fixed localization construction, identifies their cotensorators. Evaluate this equation on the presheaf unit tensor and use naturality of the sheafification unit. Cancel the tensor of the comparison isomorphisms to obtain the desired formula for sections in the sheafification unit images.

Take the two presheaves underlying M and N, and the sheafification counit maps to M and N. The right triangle identities send each sheafification unit image back to its original section. Cotensorator naturality, tensorHom_app_tmulSection, and pullbackUnit_naturality_apply transport the preceding formula through these counit maps, proving the statement for arbitrary s and t.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0095 and 0096; Q4 formalization via the fixed monoidal localization, adjunction uniqueness, and counit descent.

lean.statement:
theorem pullback_δ_app_unit_tmulSection
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) (M N : X.Modules) (U : X.Opens)
    (s : Γ(M, U)) (t : Γ(N, U)) :
    (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (pullback f) M N).app (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
        (pullbackUnitApp f (M ⊗ N) U (tmulSection s t)) =
      tmulSection (pullbackUnitApp f M U s) (pullbackUnitApp f N U t)
